reported_issues: System appearance uses light instead of the dark desktop preference
determination: Both symptoms were introduced by the agent inspection launcher rather than changed application theme/icon code. No product workaround or system-theme change was made.
root_causes: The first launcher used a private D-Bus session and private HOME/XDG directories, causing the separate portal to report a light preference. The real desktop portal reports uint32 1 and org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme prefer-dark.

The second launcher used the real portal but still hid the user-installed Tela-Apps index.theme. Without that index its Adwaita inheritance cannot be discovered; only the built-in view-list icon resolves.
correction: Native inspection keeps disposable HOME/settings/database/identity/cache/state and the synthetic key, uses the actual desktop bus for appearance, and exposes only the existing public user icon directory through a symlink inside disposable data. The existing installed service and real data remain untouched.

regression_check.result: PASS: actual System-dark native inspection with Tela-Apps/Adwaita icon inheritance
regression_check.theme_state: [app] theme state: dark=true system-supports-color-schemes=true scheme=Default theme-name=Adwaita-empty

limits: Real host dark/System and five named icon-resolution checks; does not establish system-theme changes on every compositor or clean NixOS.
No personal transcripts/settings/keyring values or paid-provider credentials copied; the icon directory contains public graphical assets.
